passages.title: 被回收的機器人
passages.text: Every Thursday is recycling day in our building. Last Thursday, Mom asked me to help her with the {1} before school. She gave me two big boxes. "Take these downstairs and {2} them," she said. I carried the boxes down and put them next to the paper {3} bin. That evening, Dad came home and looked everywhere. "Where are my robot toys? They were in two boxes in the closet!" My face turned white. We ran downstairs, but the truck had already taken everything away. Dad was sad for a whole week. Then on his birthday, I gave him a robot I made from old bottles and cans, things I took out of the {4}. "It's not the same," he said, "but I love it." Now he {5} it on the wall above his desk, and Mom checks every box twice before recycling day.

blanks.why: help her with the chores「幫她做家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不能用 help with 表示要幫忙做的事。
recycle them「把它們（箱子）拿去回收」，and 連接兩個祈使句，用原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 them。
the paper recycling bin「紙類回收桶」。sleeping、crying、arriving 都不能和 bin 組成「回收桶」。
took out of the trash「從垃圾裡拿出來的」，用舊瓶子和罐子做機器人。weather、history、fever 都不能從裡面拿東西出來。
hangs it on the wall「把它掛在牆上」，主詞 he 加 s。arrives、cries、sleeps 都不能接受詞 it。

passages.zh: 我們大樓每個星期四是回收日。上星期四，媽媽要我上學前幫她做家事。她給我兩個大箱子。「把這些拿下樓回收。」她說。我把箱子搬下去，放在紙類回收桶旁邊。那天傍晚，爸爸回家後到處找。「我的機器人玩具呢？它們在衣櫃裡的兩個箱子裡啊！」我的臉都白了。我們衝下樓，但回收車早就把東西全載走了。爸爸難過了一整個星期。後來他生日那天，我送他一個用舊瓶子和罐子做的機器人，那些都是我從垃圾裡撿出來的。「不一樣啦，」他說，「但我很喜歡。」現在他把它掛在書桌上方的牆上，而媽媽每到回收日都會把每個箱子檢查兩遍。

passages.title: 襯衫上的熨斗印
passages.text: My sister wanted to look nice for her first job interview, so she decided to {1} her white shirt. She had never used the {2} before. She turned it to the highest heat and put it on the shirt. Then her phone rang, and she talked to her friend for two minutes. When she came back, there was a brown mark on the shirt in the shape of the iron! "Oh no!" she shouted. The interview was in an hour. Mom came in and said, "Don't worry." She took a small flower pin and put it on the mark. "Now it looks {3}." My sister wore the shirt to the interview and got the job. Later, she said, "My new boss liked my flower!" Now she always {4} her shirts up right after washing, so they don't get too wrinkly. And when she {5} her clothes, she never answers the phone.

blanks.why: decided to iron her shirt「決定燙襯衫」，iron 當動詞「熨燙」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 her shirt。
the iron「熨斗」，iron 當名詞。fever、weather、noise 都不能「使用」來燙衣服。
looks special「看起來很特別」，look 後接形容詞，花別針讓印子變成裝飾。honest（誠實的）、hungry（餓的）、national（國家的）都不能形容襯衫的樣子。
hangs her shirts up「把襯衫掛起來」，主詞 she 加 s。arrives、cries、sleeps 都不能接受詞。
irons her clothes「燙衣服」。arrives、sleeps、cries 都不能接受詞 her clothes。

passages.zh: 姊姊想在第一次求職面試時看起來體面一點，所以決定燙她的白襯衫。她從來沒用過熨斗。她把溫度轉到最高，放到襯衫上，這時手機響了，她跟朋友聊了兩分鐘。回來時，襯衫上多了一個熨斗形狀的咖啡色印子！「糟了！」她大叫。再一個小時就要面試了。媽媽走進來說：「別擔心。」她拿了一個小花別針別在印子上。「這樣看起來很特別。」姊姊穿那件襯衫去面試，結果錄取了。後來她說：「我的新老闆很喜歡我的花！」現在她洗完衣服一定馬上把襯衫掛起來，這樣就不會太皺。而且她燙衣服的時候，絕對不接電話。

passages.title: 家事點數大作戰
passages.text: Last month, my parents started a new system at home. Every {1} has points. Washing the dishes is five points. Taking out the {2} is three points. {3} Dad's shirts is ten points because it's hard. When we get one hundred points, we can choose a {4}. My brother and I started a race. He did the dishes every night, and I {5} all the bottles and paper in the house. I even ironed Dad's ties. In two weeks, we both had almost a hundred points. Then Mom laughed and pointed around the house. "Look! I haven't done a single chore for two weeks," she said. Dad sat on the sofa with his feet up. "This is the best system ever," he said. My brother whispered to me, "Wait... I think they won this game."

blanks.why: Every chore has points「每項家事都有點數」。weather、history、village 都不是能做來換點數的事。
take out the trash「倒垃圾」。noise、fever、history 都不能「拿出去倒」。
Ironing Dad's shirts「燙爸爸的襯衫」，動名詞當主詞。Arriving、Crying、Sleeping 都不能接受詞 Dad's shirts。
choose a gift「選一份禮物」，集滿點數的獎勵。fever、cough、noise 都不是想要的獎勵。
recycled all the bottles and paper「把所有瓶子和紙拿去回收」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞。

passages.zh: 上個月，爸媽在家裡實施了一個新制度：每項家事都有點數。洗碗五點，倒垃圾三點，燙爸爸的襯衫十點，因為很難。集到一百點，就可以選一份禮物。我和哥哥開始比賽。他每天晚上洗碗，我把家裡所有的瓶子和紙都拿去回收，甚至還燙了爸爸的領帶。兩個星期後，我們兩個都快一百點了。這時媽媽笑著指了指家裡。「你們看！我已經兩個星期沒做任何家事了。」她說。爸爸翹著腳坐在沙發上。「這是史上最棒的制度。」他說。哥哥小聲對我說：「等等……我覺得這場遊戲是他們贏了。」

passages.title: 垃圾車的音樂聲
passages.text: In Taiwan, garbage trucks play music. When you hear "Für Elise," you know it's time to run! Every night at 7:30, my neighbors and I wait on the street with bags of {1} in our hands. The truck stops for only a few minutes, so everyone has to be fast. Behind the garbage truck, there is a smaller truck for {2}. You must put bottles, cans, and paper in the right place. Last week, my friend Luca from Italy stayed with us. When he heard the music, he thought it was an ice cream truck! He ran outside with money in his hand. Everyone laughed. Dad gave him a bag of trash instead. "In Taiwan, this is one of our daily {3}," Dad said. Luca helped us {4} the bottles and took a video. Now, back in Italy, he plays "Für Elise" every time he {5} out the trash.

blanks.why: bags of trash「一袋袋的垃圾」，等垃圾車來倒。weather、history、fever 都不能裝在袋子裡。
a truck for recycling「資源回收車」。sleeping、crying、arriving 都不能說明這台車的用途。
one of our daily chores「我們每天的家事之一」。weather、noise、villages 都不是「要做的事」。
helped us recycle the bottles「幫我們回收瓶子」，help 後接原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the bottles。
take out the trash「倒垃圾」，主詞 he 加 s。arrives、sleeps、rises 都不能和 out the trash 搭配。

passages.zh: 在台灣，垃圾車會放音樂。一聽到〈給愛麗絲〉，就知道該跑了！每天晚上七點半，我和鄰居們都會手提一袋袋的垃圾在街上等。垃圾車只停幾分鐘，所以大家都要動作快。垃圾車後面還有一台比較小的資源回收車，瓶子、罐子和紙類都要放對地方。上星期，我的義大利朋友 Luca 住在我們家。他一聽到音樂，以為是冰淇淋車，拿著錢就衝出去了！大家都笑了。爸爸改遞給他一袋垃圾。「在台灣，這是我們每天的家事之一。」爸爸說。Luca 幫我們回收瓶子，還拍了影片。現在他回到義大利，每次倒垃圾都會放〈給愛麗絲〉。

passages.title: 後台的造型師
passages.text: My cousin Grace is a stylist for the girl group Moonlight. People think her job is exciting, but it's mostly hard work. Before every concert, she has to {1} fifty costumes. She {2} each costume on a rack with the singer's name on it. During the show, the singers change clothes six times in two hours, so Grace has to be very fast. After the concert, the floor backstage is full of {3}: water bottles, tissues, and snack bags. Grace and her team {4} what they can before they go home at midnight. "It's not as glamorous as it looks," she told me. "My feet hurt, and I always smell like hair spray. But when the singers come back and say, 'Thank you, Grace,' all the hard work is {5} it."

blanks.why: has to iron fifty costumes「得燙五十套表演服」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 costumes。
hangs each costume on a rack「把每套衣服掛在衣架上」。arrives、sleeps、cries 都不能接受詞。
full of trash「滿是垃圾」，後面列出水瓶、面紙、零食袋。weather、history、fever 都不能散落在地上。
recycle what they can「能回收的都回收」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 what they can。
be worth it「值得」。national、modern、honest 都不能和 it 組成「值得」的意思。

passages.zh: 我表姊 Grace 是女團 Moonlight 的造型師。大家以為她的工作很刺激，其實大多是辛苦活。每場演唱會前，她都得燙五十套表演服，再把每套掛在寫著歌手名字的衣架上。表演時，歌手兩小時內要換六次衣服，所以 Grace 動作要非常快。演唱會結束後，後台地上滿是垃圾：水瓶、面紙和零食袋。Grace 和她的團隊在半夜回家前，會把能回收的都回收。「沒有看起來那麼光鮮亮麗，」她告訴我，「我的腳很痛，身上老是有髮膠味。但當歌手們回來說『謝謝你，Grace』的時候，再辛苦都值得。」

passages.title: 鋼鐵人會燙衣服嗎
passages.text: My little brother, Leo, is five, and he loves Iron Man. Last Sunday, Mom was doing {1} in the living room. She took out the {2} to make Dad's shirts smooth. Leo watched her and asked, "Mom, is that Iron Man's tool?" Mom laughed. "No, this is an iron. I use it to {3} clothes." Leo thought for a long time. Then he said, "So Iron Man's job is ironing clothes? That's why he's so strong!" Now, every time Mom irons, Leo stands next to her in his Iron Man mask. He also helps her {4} the shirts in the closet. Yesterday, he asked Dad, "When I grow up, can I be Iron Man and do all the ironing?" Dad smiled and said, "Of course. Every family needs a hero for the {5}."

blanks.why: doing chores「做家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不能和 do 組成「做家事」。
took out the iron「拿出熨斗」，用來把襯衫燙平。fever、cough、noise 都不能拿出來燙衣服。
use it to iron clothes「用它來燙衣服」，to 後接原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 clothes。
helps her hang the shirts「幫她把襯衫掛進衣櫃」，help 後接原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the shirts。
a hero for the laundry「洗衣燙衣的英雄」。village、noise、distance 都和燙衣服的家事無關。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Leo 五歲，超愛鋼鐵人。上星期天，媽媽在客廳做家事，她拿出熨斗要把爸爸的襯衫燙平。Leo 看著她問：「媽媽，那是鋼鐵人的工具嗎？」媽媽笑了。「不是，這是熨斗（iron），我用它來燙衣服。」Leo 想了很久，然後說：「所以鋼鐵人的工作是燙衣服？難怪他那麼強壯！」現在每次媽媽燙衣服，Leo 都戴著鋼鐵人面具站在旁邊，還會幫她把襯衫掛進衣櫃。昨天他問爸爸：「我長大以後可以當鋼鐵人，負責燙所有的衣服嗎？」爸爸笑著說：「當然可以，每個家庭都需要一位洗衣英雄。」

passages.title: 寶特瓶機器人 Bobby
passages.text: Our school held a contest called "Trash to Treasure." Every class had to make something from {1}. Our class decided to build a giant robot. For two weeks, we collected bottles, boxes, and old cans. Instead of throwing them away, we {2} them into arms, legs, and a head. Jack, who is good at art, painted the robot silver. Then we used strings to {3} bottle caps on its body like buttons. The robot was two meters tall, and we named it Bobby Bottle. On the day of the contest, everyone laughed when Bobby's head fell off in front of the principal. But we still won second {4}. After the contest, Bobby moved to the school library. He stands next to the door with a sign that says, "Please {5} your bottles. Or you might become my brother!"

blanks.why: make something from trash「用垃圾做東西」，比賽名稱就是「垃圾變寶物」。weather、history、fever 都不能拿來做東西。
recycled them into arms, legs, and a head「把它們再利用做成手、腳和頭」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞 them。
to hang bottle caps on its body「把瓶蓋掛在它身上」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 bottle caps。
won second place「得到第二名」。weather、fever、noise 都不能和 second 組成名次。
recycle your bottles「回收你的瓶子」，祈使句用原形。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 your bottles。

passages.zh: 我們學校舉辦了一場叫「垃圾變寶物」的比賽，每一班都要用垃圾做出一樣東西。我們班決定做一個巨大的機器人。兩個星期裡，我們收集了瓶子、箱子和舊罐子，沒有把它們丟掉，而是拿來做成手、腳和頭。很會畫畫的 Jack 把機器人漆成銀色，接著我們用繩子把瓶蓋掛在它身上當作鈕扣。機器人有兩公尺高，我們叫它「寶特瓶 Bobby」。比賽那天，Bobby 的頭在校長面前掉了下來，大家都笑翻了。但我們還是得了第二名。比賽結束後，Bobby 搬到學校圖書館，站在門邊，身上掛著一個牌子：「請回收你的瓶子，不然你可能會變成我的兄弟！」

passages.title: 海龜肚子裡的塑膠袋
passages.text: Last month, a sea turtle was found on a beach in Penghu. It was very sick. When the doctors checked it, they found plastic bags in its stomach. The turtle thought the bags were jellyfish. Our teacher told us this story in class. "Plastic is a big problem," she said. "If we don't {1} it, it often ends up in the sea." After class, we made a plan. We put three {2} cans in the classroom: one for paper, one for plastic, and one for everything else. We also decided to {3} posters in the hallway to remind everyone. Now, sorting trash is one of our daily {4}. A month later, our teacher showed us some good news. The turtle was {5} again, and the doctors had let it swim back into the sea. Everyone in the class cheered.

blanks.why: If we don't recycle it「如果我們不回收塑膠」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 it。
trash cans「垃圾桶」，分成紙類、塑膠和一般垃圾。weather、history、fever 都不能和 cans 組成「桶子」。
decided to hang posters「決定掛海報」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 posters。
one of our daily chores「我們每天的工作之一」。weather、noise、villages 都不是每天要做的事。
was healthy again「又恢復健康了」，所以能游回大海。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、national（國家的）都不能說明海龜病好了。

passages.zh: 上個月，有人在澎湖的海灘上發現一隻海龜，牠病得很重。醫生檢查後，在牠胃裡找到塑膠袋——海龜以為那些袋子是水母。老師在課堂上跟我們說了這個故事。「塑膠是個大問題，」她說，「如果我們不回收，它常常會跑到海裡。」下課後，我們訂了一個計畫：在教室裡放三個垃圾桶，一個放紙、一個放塑膠，一個放其他垃圾。我們也決定在走廊掛海報提醒大家。現在，垃圾分類是我們每天的工作之一。一個月後，老師告訴我們一個好消息：那隻海龜恢復健康了，醫生已經讓牠游回大海。全班都歡呼了起來。

passages.title: 京都街頭找垃圾桶
passages.text: Last summer, my family traveled to Kyoto, Japan. The streets were very clean, but we had a strange problem: we couldn't find any {1} cans! In Japan, people usually take their trash home. After lunch, I had an empty bottle and a paper bag in my hands, and I carried them for three hours. At our hotel, a worker explained that people in Japan {2} almost everything. There were different bins for cans, bottles, paper, and plastic. In our hotel room, there was a small {3} on the desk, so Mom used it to {4} Dad's wrinkly shirt for dinner. I learned a lot on this trip. Now I always carry a small bag for my trash when I go out, and I {5} my bottles before I put them in the recycling bin.

blanks.why: trash cans「垃圾桶」，在街上找不到。weather、history、fever 都不能和 cans 組成「桶子」。
recycle almost everything「幾乎什麼都回收」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 everything。
a small iron「一個小熨斗」，iron 當名詞，後面媽媽用它燙襯衫。fever、cough、noise 都不能放在桌上使用。
used it to iron Dad's shirt「用它來燙爸爸的襯衫」，iron 當動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞。
wash my bottles「把瓶子洗乾淨」再回收。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 my bottles。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家去日本京都旅行。街道非常乾淨，但我們遇到一個怪問題：怎麼找都找不到垃圾桶！在日本，人們通常會把垃圾帶回家。吃完午餐後，我手上拿著一個空瓶子和一個紙袋，就這樣拿了三個小時。在飯店，一位員工解釋說，日本人幾乎什麼都回收，罐子、瓶子、紙類和塑膠都有不同的回收桶。我們房間的桌上有一個小熨斗，所以媽媽用它把爸爸皺皺的襯衫燙好去吃晚餐。這趟旅行我學到很多。現在我出門都會帶一個小袋子裝垃圾，而且瓶子會先洗乾淨再放進回收桶。

passages.title: 哆啦A夢的家事機器人
passages.text: Nobita hates doing {1}. One Saturday, his mom told him to take out the {2}, clean his room, and {3} the wet clothes on the balcony. "Doraemon, help me!" Nobita cried. Doraemon took a small robot out of his {4}. "This is the Chore Robot," he said. "It does everything for you." The robot worked very fast. In ten minutes, the clothes were drying in the sun, and Nobita's room was {5}. Nobita lay on the floor and read comics. But then the robot found Nobita's math test under the bed. The score was zero. "Trash!" the robot said, and it threw the test into the trash bag. Nobita smiled. But when his mom came to check his room, the first thing she saw was the test, right on top of the bag. "Nobita!" she shouted. Doraemon just shook his head.

blanks.why: hates doing chores「討厭做家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不能和 do 組成「做家事」。
take out the trash「倒垃圾」。history、fever、lesson 都不能「拿出去倒」。
hang the wet clothes on the balcony「把濕衣服晾在陽台」，和 take out、clean 並列用原形。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the clothes。
took a robot out of his pocket「從口袋裡拿出機器人」。weather、fever、history 都不能裝東西。
his room was clean「房間乾淨了」。honest、polite、hungry 都是形容人的，不能形容房間。

passages.zh: 大雄討厭做家事。一個星期六，媽媽要他倒垃圾、整理房間，還要把濕衣服晾到陽台上。「哆啦A夢，救我！」大雄大叫。哆啦A夢從口袋裡拿出一個小機器人。「這是家事機器人，」他說，「它什麼都會幫你做。」機器人動作超快，十分鐘後，衣服已經在太陽下晾著，大雄的房間也乾淨了。大雄躺在地上看漫畫。但接著機器人在床底下找到大雄的數學考卷，分數是零分。「垃圾！」機器人說完，就把考卷丟進垃圾袋。大雄笑了。可是媽媽來檢查房間時，第一眼就看到那張考卷，正好在垃圾袋的最上面。「大雄！」她大吼。哆啦A夢只是搖了搖頭。

passages.title: 只做一半的家事
passages.text: My brother Max is a master of excuses. Every Saturday, Mom gives us a list of {1}. Last Saturday, my list said: take out the {2}, {3} my school shirts, and {4} the old newspapers. I finished everything in an hour. Max had the same list, but at lunchtime he was still lying on the sofa. "Max, did you do your chores?" Mom asked. "I did half of them," he said. "Which half?" "The thinking half. I thought about all of them very carefully." Mom didn't laugh. "Good. Now you can do the doing half," she said. "And because you're so good at thinking, you can also {5} up everyone's clothes after dinner." Max looked at me for help. I just smiled and went to my room to play games.

blanks.why: a list of chores「一張家事清單」。weather、noise、villages 都不是要做的事，不能列在清單上給人做。
take out the trash「倒垃圾」。history、fever、lesson 都不能「拿出去倒」。
iron my school shirts「燙我的制服襯衫」，清單上的動作用原形。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 my shirts。
recycle the old newspapers「把舊報紙拿去回收」。arrive、cry、happen 都不能接受詞 newspapers。
hang up everyone's clothes「把大家的衣服掛起來」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能和 up 組成「掛起來」，也不能接受詞 clothes。

passages.zh: 我哥哥 Max 是找藉口的高手。每個星期六，媽媽都會給我們一張家事清單。上星期六，我的清單寫著：倒垃圾、燙制服襯衫、把舊報紙拿去回收。我一個小時就全做完了。Max 的清單一模一樣，但到了中午他還躺在沙發上。「Max，你家事做了嗎？」媽媽問。「我做了一半。」他說。「哪一半？」「思考的那一半。我把每一項都很仔細地想過了。」媽媽沒有笑。「很好，那你現在可以去做『動手』的那一半了，」她說，「而且你這麼會思考，晚餐後大家的衣服也交給你掛。」Max 看著我求救，我只是笑一笑，回房間打電動去了。

passages.title: 掛歪的全家福
passages.text: Last Sunday, Dad bought a big frame for our family photo. "I'll {1} it in the living room," he said proudly. He took out a hammer and some nails. Mom asked, "Do you need help?" "No, I can do it myself," Dad answered. After an hour, the photo was on the wall, but it was not {2}. "It looks fine," Dad said. But every time we walked past it, we turned our heads to the side. There were also little pieces of the wall all over the floor, so I had to {3} them up. I put the pieces and the bent nails in the {4}. That evening, while Dad was doing other {5} in the kitchen, Mom quietly fixed the photo. Dad didn't notice anything. Later, he looked at the wall and said, "See? I told you it was fine." Mom and I just smiled at each other.

blanks.why: I'll hang it「我來把它掛起來」，will 後接原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 it。
it was not straight「照片掛得不正」，後面說大家都要歪著頭看。honest、hungry、polite 都是形容人的，不能形容照片。
sweep them up「把它們掃起來」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 them。
put … in the trash「丟進垃圾桶」。weather、history、fever 都不能把東西放進去。
doing other chores「做其他家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不能和 do 組成「做家事」。

passages.zh: 上星期天，爸爸買了一個大相框裝全家福。「我來把它掛在客廳。」他得意地說。他拿出槌子和幾根釘子。媽媽問：「需要幫忙嗎？」「不用，我自己來就好。」爸爸回答。一個小時後，照片掛上牆了，但掛得歪歪的。「看起來很好啊。」爸爸說。可是我們每次經過，都會不自覺地歪著頭看。地上也到處是牆壁的小碎片，所以我得把它們掃起來。我把碎片和彎掉的釘子丟進垃圾桶。那天晚上，趁爸爸在廚房做其他家事時，媽媽悄悄把照片調正了。爸爸完全沒發現。後來他看著牆壁說：「看吧？我就說沒問題。」媽媽和我只是互看一眼，笑了。

passages.title: 愛翻垃圾桶的小豆
passages.text: Our puppy, Bean, has a bad {1}. Every time we leave the house, he opens the {2} can in the kitchen. Yesterday, we came home and saw paper, banana skins, and old noodles all over the floor. Bean was sitting in the middle, wagging his tail. "Who did this?" Mom asked. Bean looked away. Cleaning up was not fun. I picked up the garbage, and my sister {3} the floor. Then Dad had an idea. He put the trash can on top of the washing machine and decided to {4} the recycling bags high on the back door. Now Bean can't reach them. We thought the problem was solved. But today, when we came home, Bean was asleep on Dad's white shirts, the ones Mom had just {5}. They were now covered in brown dog hair. "Bean!" Mom shouted. Bean just opened one eye and went back to sleep.

blanks.why: a bad habit「壞習慣」，後面說每次都翻垃圾桶。weather、fever、village 都不能用來說狗的行為習慣。
the trash can「垃圾桶」。weather、history、fever 都不能和 can 組成「桶子」。
mopped the floor「拖地」。laughed、appeared、smiled 都不能直接接 the floor。
decided to hang the recycling bags「決定把回收袋掛起來」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the bags。
the ones Mom had just ironed「媽媽剛燙好的那些（襯衫）」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能有受詞，不能修飾 shirts。

passages.zh: 我們家的小狗小豆有個壞習慣：只要我們出門，牠就會打開廚房的垃圾桶。昨天我們回家時，看到紙屑、香蕉皮和剩麵條散落一地，小豆坐在正中間搖著尾巴。「這是誰做的？」媽媽問。小豆把頭轉開。打掃一點都不好玩，我撿垃圾，妹妹拖地。後來爸爸想到一個辦法：他把垃圾桶放到洗衣機上面，再把回收袋高高掛在後門上。現在小豆搆不到了。我們以為問題解決了。但今天回家時，小豆正睡在爸爸的白襯衫上，那些是媽媽剛燙好的，現在沾滿了咖啡色的狗毛。「小豆！」媽媽大叫。小豆只睜開一隻眼睛，又繼續睡了。

passages.title: 阿嬤的回收推車
passages.text: My grandma is seventy-five, but she works harder than anyone I know. Every morning, she pushes an old cart around the village and collects things to {1}: cans, bottles, and old paper. She sells them to the recycling center and gives all the money to a children's home. Some people think she is poor, but she isn't. "Why do you do it, Grandma?" I asked her once. "Because I don't like to see good things in the {2}," she said. Last summer, I went with her. It was hot, and the bags were {3}. My back hurt after one hour, but Grandma didn't stop. After that, I wanted to do more for her, so I started helping with her {4} at home too. Every weekend, I {5} her blouses and swept the yard. "Now I have more time to collect bottles," she said happily.

blanks.why: collects things to recycle「收集可以回收的東西」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能用來說明「要拿去做什麼的東西」。
good things in the trash「被丟進垃圾裡的好東西」。weather、history、fever 都不能裝東西。
the bags were heavy「袋子很重」，後面說背很痛。honest、polite、national 都不能形容袋子的重量。
helping with her chores「幫忙做她的家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不是能幫忙做的事。
ironed her blouses「燙她的襯衫」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞 her blouses。

passages.zh: 我阿嬤七十五歲了，卻比我認識的任何人都還要勤勞。每天早上，她推著一台舊推車在村子裡繞，收集可以回收的東西：罐子、瓶子和舊紙。她把它們賣給回收場，再把錢全部捐給育幼院。有些人以為她很窮，其實不是。「阿嬤，你為什麼要這樣做？」有一次我問她。「因為我不喜歡看到好東西被丟進垃圾裡。」她說。去年夏天，我跟她一起去。天氣很熱，袋子很重，一個小時後我的背就痛了，但阿嬤一直沒停下來。之後我想多幫她一點，就開始幫她做家裡的家事。每個週末，我幫她燙襯衫、掃院子。「這樣我就有更多時間收瓶子了。」她開心地說。

passages.title: 只差兩個瓶子
passages.text: This semester, our school had a recycling contest. The class that collected the most bottles would win a pizza party. Our class really wanted to win. We put a big box at the back of the classroom, and every day we brought bottles from home. Some students even asked their neighbors for empty bottles. Our class leader made a chart and used tape to {1} it on the wall. Doing {2} for the contest became fun. We washed every bottle and took the labels off before we {3} them. On the last day, we had 1,230 bottles! But Class 9-3 had 1,232. We lost by two bottles. Then our teacher found two bottles in the {4} can next to her desk. "Oh no, too late!" she laughed. The principal felt sorry for us, so he gave us a {5} too: a big box of cookies.

blanks.why: used tape to hang it on the wall「用膠帶把它（圖表）貼掛在牆上」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 it。
Doing chores「做這些工作」，動名詞當主詞。weather、noise、villages 都不能和 do 組成「做事」。
before we recycled them「在我們回收瓶子之前」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞 them。
in the trash can「在垃圾桶裡」，老師把瓶子丟錯地方。weather、history、fever 都不能和 can 組成「桶子」。
gave us a prize「也給我們一份獎品」，就是一盒餅乾。fever、cough、noise 都不是會送人的獎品。

passages.zh: 這學期，我們學校舉辦了資源回收比賽，收集最多瓶子的班級可以贏得披薩派對。我們班超想贏。我們在教室後面放了一個大箱子，每天都從家裡帶瓶子來，有些同學甚至去跟鄰居要空瓶。班長做了一張圖表，用膠帶貼在牆上。為比賽做這些事變得很好玩：每個瓶子回收前，我們都會洗乾淨、撕掉標籤。最後一天，我們有 1,230 個瓶子！可是九年三班有 1,232 個，我們只輸兩個瓶子。這時老師在她桌子旁的垃圾桶裡找到兩個瓶子。「哎呀，來不及了！」她笑著說。校長覺得我們很可惜，所以也送我們一份獎品：一大盒餅乾。

passages.title: 畢業照前一晚
passages.text: Tomorrow is the day for our graduation photos. Mom told me to {1} my school uniform tonight. "You're fifteen now," she said. "You can do it yourself." I put the shirt on the ironing board and turned on the {2}. First, I did the collar, and then the sleeves. It was harder than I thought. Every time I finished one side, the other side got wrinkly again. After thirty minutes, the shirt finally looked good. I put it on a hanger and went to {3} it on my door. Then I remembered my skirt. I had to iron that too! By the time I finished, it was eleven o'clock. My little brother had already done all his {4} and was fast asleep. The next morning, I put on my uniform. In the photo, my clothes looked perfect, but I looked very {5}.

blanks.why: told me to iron my school uniform「叫我燙制服」，iron 當動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 my uniform。
turned on the iron「打開熨斗」，iron 當名詞。fever、cough、noise 都不能打開開關。
went to hang it on my door「去把它掛在門上」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 it。
done all his chores「做完他所有的家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不能和 do 組成「做家事」。
looked very tired「看起來很累」，因為前一晚弄到十一點。national、modern、wooden 都不能形容人的精神狀態。

passages.zh: 明天要拍畢業照。媽媽叫我今晚把制服燙好。「你十五歲了，」她說，「可以自己來。」我把襯衫放在燙衣板上，打開熨斗，先燙衣領，再燙袖子。比我想像的難多了，每次燙好一邊，另一邊又皺了。三十分鐘後，襯衫終於看起來不錯了。我把它套上衣架，掛到房門上。然後我想起還有裙子，那也要燙！等我燙完，已經十一點了。弟弟早就做完他所有的家事，睡得很熟了。隔天早上，我穿上制服。照片裡我的衣服完美無缺，但我看起來好累。

passages.title: 從天花板掉下來的蜘蛛
passages.text: Our English teacher, Ms. Hill, is from the US, and she loves Halloween. Every October, she asks us to {1} the classroom. This year, we made spiders from old black socks and paper bags. We didn't buy anything. We just used things we were going to {2}. Then we stood on chairs and started to {3} the spiders from the ceiling. Tom made a huge one with eight long legs. When Ms. Hill walked in, it fell right on her head! She screamed so loudly that the class next door came to see what happened. Then she started laughing. "Best Halloween ever!" she said. After the party, there was a lot of {4} on the floor: candy wrappers, paper cups, and pieces of string. Cleaning up was our last {5} of the day, and Ms. Hill helped us, still wearing a spider in her hair.

blanks.why: asks us to decorate the classroom「要我們布置教室」，to 後接原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the classroom。
things we were going to recycle「我們原本要拿去回收的東西」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能用來說明「要拿去回收的物品」。
hang the spiders from the ceiling「把蜘蛛掛在天花板上」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the spiders。
a lot of trash on the floor「地上有很多垃圾」，後面舉例糖果紙和紙杯。weather、history、fever 都不能散落在地上。
our last chore「我們最後一項工作」，指打掃。weather、noise、village 都不能是「要做的工作」。

passages.zh: 我們的英文老師 Hill 老師來自美國，非常喜歡萬聖節。每年十月，她都會要我們布置教室。今年，我們用舊黑襪子和紙袋做蜘蛛，什麼都沒買，只用原本要拿去回收的東西。接著我們站到椅子上，開始把蜘蛛掛在天花板上。Tom 做了一隻有八條長腳的超大蜘蛛。Hill 老師一走進來，它就正好掉在她頭上！她尖叫得好大聲，隔壁班都跑來看發生什麼事。然後她開始大笑。「這是最棒的萬聖節！」她說。派對結束後，地上有好多垃圾：糖果紙、紙杯和一段段的繩子。打掃是我們那天最後一項工作，Hill 老師也來幫忙，頭髮上還掛著一隻蜘蛛。

passages.title: 被風吹走的內褲
passages.text: Last Saturday was sunny and windy, so Mom asked me to {1} the laundry on the balcony. I did it quickly because I wanted to play games. That afternoon, someone rang our {2}. It was Mr. Chen, the man who lives downstairs. He was holding something pink. "Is this yours?" he asked. It was Dad's underwear, with cartoon hearts on it! The wind had carried it down to Mr. Chen's balcony. Dad's face turned red. "Uh... thank you," he said. After Mr. Chen left, everybody laughed except Dad. "Next time, use more clothespins," he told me. My punishment? I had to take out the {3} every day for a week. That evening, Dad took all the clothes in himself. He {4} his shirts in his bedroom, far away from the window, and he never let me touch his {5} again.

blanks.why: asked me to hang the laundry「叫我晾衣服」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the laundry。
rang our doorbell「按我們家的門鈴」。weather、fever、history 都不能按。
take out the trash「倒垃圾」，當作處罰。weather、history、fever 都不能「拿出去倒」。
ironed his shirts「燙他的襯衫」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞 his shirts。
never let me touch his laundry「再也不讓我碰他要洗的衣服」。village、noise、distance 都不能「碰」，也和曬衣服無關。

passages.zh: 上星期六天氣晴朗、風很大，媽媽叫我把衣服晾到陽台上。我想趕快去打電動，所以晾得很快。那天下午，有人按我們家的門鈴，是住樓下的陳先生，手上拿著一個粉紅色的東西。「這是你們家的嗎？」他問。那是爸爸的內褲，上面還有卡通愛心！風把它吹到陳先生家的陽台上了。爸爸的臉都紅了。「呃……謝謝。」他說。陳先生走後，除了爸爸，大家都笑翻了。「下次多夾幾個曬衣夾。」他對我說。我的處罰？一整個星期都要倒垃圾。那天傍晚，爸爸自己把所有衣服收進來，在遠離窗戶的臥室裡燙他的襯衫，而且再也不讓我碰他的衣服了。

passages.title: 偶像的家事大挑戰
passages.text: Last night, I watched a funny variety show. In it, three idols from the band Neon Kids had to live alone for a day and do all their own {1}. The first idol, Jin, tried to {2} his shirt, but he forgot to turn the iron on. He moved it over the shirt for ten minutes and wondered why nothing happened. The second idol, Woo, didn't know how to {3} things. He put a banana skin in the bottle bin! The third idol, Kai, was the best. He {4} the dishes, took out the {5}, and even cooked dinner for the others. At the end of the show, the host asked, "Who learned the most today?" Jin raised his hand. "Me! I learned that an iron needs power." Everyone in the studio laughed, and Jin's fans called him "Iron Prince" for a month.

blanks.why: do all their own chores「自己做所有的家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不能和 do 組成「做家事」。
tried to iron his shirt「試著燙襯衫」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 his shirt。
how to recycle things「怎麼做資源回收」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 things。
washed the dishes「洗碗」。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞 the dishes。
took out the trash「倒垃圾」。weather、history、fever 都不能「拿出去倒」。

passages.zh: 昨晚我看了一個很好笑的綜藝節目。節目裡，男團 Neon Kids 的三位偶像要自己生活一天，所有家事都自己做。第一位偶像 Jin 想燙襯衫，卻忘了打開熨斗電源，他把熨斗在襯衫上推了十分鐘，一直搞不懂為什麼沒效果。第二位 Woo 不知道怎麼做資源回收，竟然把香蕉皮丟進瓶罐回收桶！第三位 Kai 表現最好，他洗了碗、倒了垃圾，甚至還幫其他人煮晚餐。節目最後，主持人問：「今天誰學到最多？」Jin 舉手說：「我！我學到熨斗要插電。」攝影棚裡的人都笑了，Jin 的粉絲還叫了他一個月的「熨斗王子」。

passages.title: 會說話的垃圾桶
passages.text: My uncle is an engineer, and he loves to make new things. Last month, he made a smart {1} can for our family. It can talk! When you throw something away, it looks at it with a small camera. If you put a bottle in it, it says, "Please {2} this!" It also reminds us of our {3}. Every morning, it says, "Good morning! Today, Dad needs to {4} his shirts, and Amy needs to {5} the wet towels on the balcony." At first, we loved it. But after a week, it became a little annoying. Once, my brother threw away a banana skin, and it said, "Banana again? You need to eat more vegetables!" Another time, it told everyone that Dad had eaten three bags of chips. Now Dad turns it off every night before he eats his snacks.

blanks.why: a smart trash can「智慧垃圾桶」。weather、history、fever 都不能和 can 組成「桶子」。
Please recycle this!「這個請回收！」please 後接原形動詞。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 this。
reminds us of our chores「提醒我們要做的家事」。weather、noise、villages 都不是每天要做的工作。
needs to iron his shirts「要燙襯衫」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 his shirts。
needs to hang the wet towels「要把濕毛巾晾起來」。arrive、cry、rise 都不能接受詞 the towels。

passages.zh: 我舅舅是工程師，很喜歡做新東西。上個月，他幫我們家做了一個智慧垃圾桶——它會說話！你丟東西時，它會用一個小鏡頭看一看。如果丟的是瓶子，它會說：「這個請回收！」它也會提醒我們要做的家事。每天早上它都會說：「早安！今天爸爸要燙襯衫，Amy 要把濕毛巾晾到陽台上。」一開始我們都很喜歡它，但一個星期後，它變得有點煩。有一次弟弟丟了一塊香蕉皮，它說：「又是香蕉？你要多吃點蔬菜！」還有一次，它跟大家說爸爸吃了三包洋芋片。現在爸爸每天晚上吃零食前，都會先把它關掉。
